kioskAccess.howTitle: How to set up your kiosk
kioskAccess.howSubtitle: Four steps, from any Android tablet, iPad, or phone.
steps: Open the address above in your tablet or phone browser (Chrome or Safari) — or scan the QR code.
Add the page to your home screen so it opens like an app.
Put it in full screen. On iPad/iPhone use "Guided Access"; on Android use screen pinning to lock it on the kiosk.
Place the tablet or phone on your counter. Paid orders go straight to your kitchen display.
kioskAccess.tip: Tip: any tablet or Android/iPhone with a browser works. No special hardware to buy.
kioskAccess.noHardwareTitle: One-person taco shop? You don't even need a kiosk
kioskAccess.noHardwareBody: With QR Menu, customers order and pay from their own phone by scanning a code at the counter — zero hardware to buy or set up.
